name: Shinomiya Noel
source:
Lucia’s older sister, [spoiler] who had been possessed by the demon Astaroth since before her birth, Yuriko was originally possessed by this demon, but he moved to her daughter’s body while she was still in her womb.
The girl exhibited abnormal behavior from a very early age, In addition to not fully realizing she had been possessed by something like a demon, she hated listening to and reading the Bible, and little by little the demon took more control of her until she ended up killing her father and escaping. 
After her escape, she was taken into the care of an orphanage until she returned and met Lucia again during the events of her route.
She died shortly after Astaroth was exorcize from her body since was the contract with him that keep her alive until that moment [/spoiler]
